Description.DefaultText: Hidden counter: ticks until the fair folk may next play a trick in a realm.

//FaerieClock: Feature 30 (plan section 30): the hour clock of the Faerie Realm's danger roll, Tgr_HW_FaerieTricks. Rises 1 a tick to its top of 4 (FAERIE_CLOCK_TICKS, one hour, a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER) and waits there while the player is away; the roll fires at the top while hw_stat_in_realm reads 1 and takes 4 off it.
